title: [YSQL] YqlTest.TabletMetadataViewsWithYcqlAndYsql is flaky

labels.name: kind/enhancement
labels.description: This is an enhancement of an existing feature

body:
Jira Link: [DB-19200](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-19200)
### Description

Fails on release builds with:
```
*** SIGSEGV (@0xd8) received by PID 22179 (TID 0x7f4b75638700) from PID 216; stack trace: ***
    @     0x7f8b9defc0c1 yb::tserver::TabletServer::SharedObject()
```
